title: Catalan Spinach
description: A traditional Christmas side dish: spinach sautéed with pine nuts, raisins and garlic, with a sweet Mediterranean touch.

instructions.title: Wash the spinach
instructions.description: Wash the spinach well and drain it, keeping the tenderest leaves.

instructions.title: Soften the raisins
instructions.description: Soften the raisins briefly in warm water or sherry.

instructions.title: Toast the pine nuts
instructions.description: In a large pan, toast the pine nuts in the oil and set them aside.

instructions.title: Sauté the spinach
instructions.description: Sauté the sliced garlic cloves and add the spinach in batches, stirring until it wilts completely.

instructions.title: Finish and serve
instructions.description: Add the raisins and pine nuts, season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
